definitions.explanation: A male child. A formal or official word used on documents, in news, and in set phrases rather than in casual speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧な{男児|だんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
{第一子|だいいっし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男児|だんじ}だった。
examples.english: Their first child was a boy.

examples.japanese: 「{日本男児|にほんだんじ}」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: The phrase "a Japanese man" carries old-fashioned values.

notes:
Formal and official; common in birth announcements and news. Everyday speech uses ⟦{男|おとこ}の{子|こ}→男の子：02862_otokonoko⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男児|だんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出産|しゅっさん}する→出産する：26987_shussansuru⟧: to give birth to a boy
- {日本男児|にほんだんじ}: a Japanese man (with connotations of manliness)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{男|おとこ}の{子|こ}→男の子：02862_otokonoko⟧: boy — everyday, neutral
- ⟦{女児|じょじ}→女児：28058_joji⟧: female child — the female counterpart
